_comment: Example only. Every environment-specific value is blank, zero or an empty list, so validation fails closed (minLength, minValue) until an approved operator populates it. Extract the section with: jq '.gateway' parameters.example.json > .local/gateway.parameters.json. Never commit populated copies. Timeouts, replica bounds, concurrency, CPU, memory and retention have no defaults on purpose: state them per environment from your own measurements. modelInferenceRoleDefinitionId is looked up in your tenant (see infra/README.md). Resource group names are blank so you state them; foundrySecondaryResourceGroupName and location are omitted and default to the deployment resource group, so add them only when a second Foundry account is used and lives elsewhere. The well-known role IDs (Key Vault Secrets User, Key Vault Secrets Officer, AcrPull) have template defaults and are not listed. Phase 2 deploys with deployGatewayApp=false; phase 5 sets deployGatewayApp=true and supplies gatewayImage (by digest) and gatewayPolicyJson at deploy time from the pipeline. No secret value belongs in this file.
